capabilities.name: 结构化决策评估
capabilities.summary: 对同一 state 并行评估多个类型化问题（System One：状态入、类型化概率决策出，无文本生成、无需解析）；含请求信封、答案表、用量回传与 422 校验错误结构

official.quote: Jev is TypeSafe's flagship model and the first [System One model](/concepts/system-one). Every model on this page is served by the same endpoint, `POST /v1/systemone`. The request's `model` field selects which one handles the call —— Jev evaluates typed *questions* against a *state* and returns structured results directly. No text generation, no parsing. All three *question* types can be mixed in a single API call. Every *question* is evaluated in parallel and in isolation against the same *state* in one go.
official.constraint: 同步单端点 POST https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone（openapi 3.1.0 机器 spec 全端点仅此 + GET /v1/models）；required=state,model,questions（SystemOneRequest.required 逐字）、questions minProperties=1；响应 required=model,answers,usage；鉴权 Authorization Bearer；上下文双预算 64k/请求合计 + 32k state+最长单题；限速 250k tok/s + 1200 req/min（动态调整中）；错误码 401/422/429/529。第二段引句出自 https://docs.typesafe.ai/introduction.md

fields.name: state
fields.description: 本次请求所有问题共同评估的内容（被判定对象）：纯字符串，或结构化程序状态（对象/数组）。官方强调以结构化程序状态为主用形态；非文本输入（图像/音频/视频/二进制）须先在代码侧预处理成文本或结构化字段再放入 state
fields.constraint: required；与 questions 合并计入 64k/请求 token 预算，state+最长单题另受 32k 预算（见 manifest specs.notes）

official.quote: "state":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"items":{},"type":"array"}],"title":"State","description":"The content all questions in this request refer to.","examples":["I was charged twice. Please help.",{"message":"Please help.","subject":"Duplicate charge"}]}

fields.name: model
fields.description: 模型名或别名（jev-latest / jev-preview / 版本化 ID jev-1.13.0）；GET /v1/models 返回本账号可用名单（当前只列别名，版本化 ID 不在列表也可直接传）。响应侧同名字段回报实际应答的模型，官方明文可能与请求里传的别名不同（May differ from the alias supplied in the request）——别名漂移的审计锚点

official.quote: "model":{"type":"string","title":"Model","description":"Name or alias of the model to use. Available names are returned by GET /v1/models.","examples":["jev-latest"]}

fields.name: questions
fields.description: 类型化问题表：键由调用方自取（问题 id，官方明文不送入模型、不参与推理），值为三种问题对象之一（noul/choice/score，discriminator=type）；所有问题对同一 state 并行、彼此隔离地评估，答案按同名键返回
fields.constraint: required；minProperties=1；单请求问题数官方明文只受 token 预算限制（primitives.md：The number of questions in one request is limited only by the request's token budget）

official.quote: "questions":{"additionalProperties":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Question"},"type":"object","minProperties":1,"title":"Questions","description":"Questions to ask about the content, each with a name you choose. The response uses those names to identify the answers.","examples":[{"billing":{"instructions":"Is this message about billing?","type":"noul"}}]}

fields.name: questions{}.type
fields.description: 问题类型判别器（{} 表示 map 任意键下的成员，下同）：noul=是非题（返回 yes 概率）/ choice=从自定义选项集选一 / score=按有序量表打分。三种可在同一请求混用
fields.constraint: required（三种问题对象的 required 均含 type）

official.quote: {"propertyName":"type","mapping":{"choice":"#/components/schemas/ChoiceQuestion","noul":"#/components/schemas/NoulQuestion","score":"#/components/schemas/ScoreQuestion"}}

override.quote: All three *question* types can be mixed in a single API call. Every *question* is evaluated in parallel and in isolation against the same *state* in one go.

fields.name: questions{}.instructions
fields.description: 问题指令：要判定/选择/打分的问题本身，收字符串或 JSON 结构（对象/数组）。机器 spec 中三种问题对象的 instructions 均可空（NoulQuestion required 仅 [type]，Choice/Score required 为 [criteria,type]）；docs API 参考页则将其标为 required——spec↔docs 分叉，以机器 spec 为 wire 口径记录，校验行为待实测
fields.constraint: 机器 spec 非 required；docs api.md 标 required（分叉已记 manifest notes）

official.quote: "instructions":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"items":{},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}],"title":"Instructions","description":"The yes/no question or statement to evaluate.","examples":["Is this message spam?","This message contains unsolicited advertising.",{"task":"Identify unsolicited advertising."}]}

fields.name: answers
fields.description: 答案表：键与请求 questions 的自取键一一对应，值类型与对应问题的 type 匹配（NoulAnswer/ChoiceAnswer/ScoreAnswer，discriminator=type）

official.quote: "answers":{"additionalProperties":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/Answer"},"type":"object","minProperties":1,"title":"Answers","description":"Answers keyed by the question names supplied in the request. Each answer's type matches its question's type.","examples":[{"billing":{"noul":0.98,"type":"noul"}}]}

fields.name: answers{}.type
fields.description: 答案类型判别器，与问题 type 一致（noul/choice/score）

official.quote: {"propertyName":"type","mapping":{"choice":"#/components/schemas/ChoiceAnswer","noul":"#/components/schemas/NoulAnswer","score":"#/components/schemas/ScoreAnswer"}}

fields.name: usage.input_tokens
fields.description: 本次评估计费输入 token 数

official.quote: "input_tokens":{"type":"integer","title":"Input Tokens","description":"Number of billable input tokens used to evaluate the request.","examples":[120]}

fields.name: usage.output_tokens
fields.description: 回答问题所用输出 token 数；官方机器 spec 内嵌声明当前免费（currently free of charge）
fields.constraint: Usage.required=[input_tokens,output_tokens]；官方无协议级数值边界（输出为类型化答案对象、token 量由问题数决定），机器 spec 亦未给 min/max——边界在模型级由问题结构决定

official.quote: "output_tokens":{"type":"integer","title":"Output Tokens","description":"Number of output tokens used to answer the questions. Output tokens are currently free of charge.","examples":[12]}

fields.name: detail
fields.description: 422 校验错误响应体：逐条列出缺失/非法的请求字段（HTTPValidationError.detail）
fields.constraint: 错误码表（docs api.md）：401 Unauthorized / 422 Unprocessable Entity / 429 Too Many Requests / 529 Overloaded（非标状态码，语义=临时过载请退避重试）

official.quote: "detail":{"items":{"$ref":"#/components/schemas/ValidationError"},"type":"array","title":"Detail","description":"Validation errors describing which request values are missing or invalid.","examples":[[{"loc":["body","state"],"msg":"Field required","type":"missing"}]]}

fields.name: detail[].loc
fields.description: 非法值路径：请求位置 + 字段名/数组下标序列

official.quote: "loc":{"items":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"type":"integer"}]},"type":"array","title":"Location","description":"Path to the invalid value: the request location followed by field names and array indices.","examples":[["body","questions","urgency","score","criteria"]]}

fields.name: detail[].msg
fields.description: 人读校验失败说明

official.quote: "msg":{"type":"string","title":"Message","description":"Human-readable explanation of the validation failure.","examples":["Field required"]}

fields.name: detail[].type
fields.description: 机读校验错误码（如 missing）

official.quote: "type":{"type":"string","title":"Error Type","description":"Machine-readable validation error code.","examples":["missing"]}

fields.name: detail[].input
fields.description: 未通过校验的输入值回显

official.quote: "input":{"title":"Input","description":"The input value that failed validation.","examples":[{"type":"score"}]}

fields.name: detail[].ctx
fields.description: 校验失败的附加上下文（如 {min_length:1}）

official.quote: "ctx":{"type":"object","title":"Context","description":"Additional context used to explain the validation failure.","examples":[{"min_length":1}]}

capabilities.name: 是非概率判定
capabilities.summary: Noul 原语：对一个是非题/命题返回「答案为是」的概率（0-1 连续值，非布尔）；可选 criteria 分别描述是/否的判定含义

official.quote: For example, "Is the customer asking for a refund?", asked as a [Noul](/primitives/noul) and as a yes/no [Choice](/primitives/choice) on the ticket "I'm not happy with the fit. What are my options here?"：（jev-1.13 官方短板页给出该 Noul 实测输出 noul=0.22，Applies to jev-1.13）
official.constraint: Noul=是非题原语：返回「答案为是」的概率 0-1（非布尔）；criteria 可选 {true:…, false:…} 澄清是/否含义（NoulQuestion.required 仅 [type]，机器 spec）；NoulAnswer.required=[noul,type]，无 confidence 字段。官方明文警示：P(noul) 与 1-P(not noul) 不保证可比（结构不变量不成立，jaggedness 页）

fields.name: questions{}.criteria
fields.description: 判据（criteria）：noul 题为可选对象 {true:…, false:…}（分别描述「是/否」各自含义）；choice 题为必填 map<选项名, 描述|null>（选项名即答案值域，官方明文无描述的选项按其名字面理解）；score 题为必填有序数组（每个元素描述一档，位置即分值、从 0 起）。choice/score 的 criteria 值同样收 JSON 结构（Advanced: structure 页）
fields.constraint: choice/score 必填、noul 可选；score 机器 spec minItems=1 而 docs api.md 写 You must include at least two levels（spec↔docs 分叉）；choice 选项数上限 255（blog 逐字 Jev supports a cardinality up to 255. + choice.md 逐字 A Choice question accepts up to 255 options）

official.quote: "criteria":{"additionalProperties":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"items":{},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}]},"type":"object","title":"Criteria","description":"Choice names and descriptions of when each applies. A choice without a description is interpreted by its name alone.","examples":[{"angry":"An upset or hostile message","calm":"A neutral or polite message","excited":"An enthusiastic or eager message"}]}

fields.name: answers{}.noul
fields.description: 是非题答案：yes/真命题的概率，0（否）到 1（是），0.5 附近表示不确定。NoulAnswer 无 confidence 字段（confidence 仅 choice/score 答案携带）

official.quote: "noul":{"type":"number","title":"Noul","description":"Probability of a yes answer or a true statement, from 0 to 1. Values near 1 favor yes or true, values near 0 favor no or false, and values near 0.5 indicate uncertainty.","examples":[0.98]}

capabilities.name: 闭集选择判定
capabilities.summary: Choice 原语：从调用方定义的选项集（criteria map）中选一，返回选中项 + 全选项概率分布 + 置信度；官方保证答案不会落在给定选项集之外

official.quote: Jev supports a cardinality up to 255.（blog，主语即 Jev，模型级）—— A Choice question accepts up to 255 options, and adding options costs a few tokens each（choice 指南页）
official.constraint: Choice=闭集选择原语：criteria 为必填 map<选项名, 描述|null>（ChoiceQuestion.required=[criteria,type]），选项数上限 255；ChoiceAnswer.required=[choice,confidence,probabilities,type]，probabilities 全选项概率合计约 1。官方保证答案约束在给定选项集内（primitives.md 逐字「**Every answer is constrained to the options you supplied.** The model returns a probability distribution over your options or levels, never a value outside them.」）。第二段引句出自 https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/choice.md

fields.name: questions{}.criteria
fields.description: 判据（criteria）：noul 题为可选对象 {true:…, false:…}（分别描述「是/否」各自含义）；choice 题为必填 map<选项名, 描述|null>（选项名即答案值域，官方明文无描述的选项按其名字面理解）；score 题为必填有序数组（每个元素描述一档，位置即分值、从 0 起）。choice/score 的 criteria 值同样收 JSON 结构（Advanced: structure 页）
fields.constraint: choice/score 必填、noul 可选；score 机器 spec minItems=1 而 docs api.md 写 You must include at least two levels（spec↔docs 分叉）；choice 选项数上限 255（blog 逐字 Jev supports a cardinality up to 255. + choice.md 逐字 A Choice question accepts up to 255 options）

official.quote: "criteria":{"additionalProperties":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"items":{},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}]},"type":"object","title":"Criteria","description":"Choice names and descriptions of when each applies. A choice without a description is interpreted by its name alone.","examples":[{"angry":"An upset or hostile message","calm":"A neutral or polite message","excited":"An enthusiastic or eager message"}]}

fields.name: answers{}.choice
fields.description: 选择题答案：criteria 中概率最高的选项名。官方保证答案只会落在调用方给定的选项集内（primitives.md：Every answer is constrained to the options you supplied…never a value outside them）

official.quote: "choice":{"type":"string","title":"Choice","description":"The name of the choice with the highest probability among the question's criteria.","examples":["angry"]}

fields.name: answers{}.probabilities
fields.description: 全量概率分布：choice 答案按选项名、score 答案按档位下标（字符串键，与 legend 同键）逐项给概率，官方口径合计约为 1（values sum to approximately 1）
fields.constraint: choice/score 答案均为 required 成员

official.quote: "probabilities":{"additionalProperties":{"type":"number"},"type":"object","title":"Probabilities","description":"Probability of each choice in criteria, keyed by choice name, from 0 to 1. Shows how likely the alternatives are; values sum to approximately 1.","examples":[{"angry":0.8,"calm":0.1,"excited":0.1}]}

fields.name: answers{}.confidence
fields.description: 置信度 0-1，由该答案的概率分布派生（confidence 页：与概率不同的第二轴，供路由/人审门控用）；仅 choice/score 答案携带，noul 答案无此字段

official.quote: "confidence":{"type":"number","title":"Confidence","description":"Confidence in the selected choice, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate greater certainty; use lower values to flag uncertain selections for review.","examples":[0.9]}

capabilities.name: 量表打分判定
capabilities.summary: Score 原语：按调用方给定的有序档位量表（criteria 数组，位置即分值）打分，返回概率加权期望分（可落在两档之间）+ 档位图例 + 逐档概率 + 置信度

official.quote: You can use the expectation to check if it passes a particular threshold, but `jev-1.13`'s score levels are weak in numerical calibration. It will not be able to help you reconstruct the exact number by interpolating between the nearest two levels.（Applies to jev-1.13——正面确认 score 原语的期望值/概率输出存在于本模型，并给出官方使用边界）
official.constraint: Score=有序量表打分原语：criteria 为必填有序数组、位置即分值从 0 起（ScoreQuestion.required=[criteria,type]；机器 spec minItems=1，docs api.md 写「An ordered array of level descriptions. You must include at least two levels.」——spec↔docs 分叉见 specs.notes）；ScoreAnswer.required=[score,confidence,legend,probabilities,type]，score 为概率加权期望、可落两档之间；官方明文勿用期望值插值重建精确数值

fields.name: questions{}.criteria
fields.description: 判据（criteria）：noul 题为可选对象 {true:…, false:…}（分别描述「是/否」各自含义）；choice 题为必填 map<选项名, 描述|null>（选项名即答案值域，官方明文无描述的选项按其名字面理解）；score 题为必填有序数组（每个元素描述一档，位置即分值、从 0 起）。choice/score 的 criteria 值同样收 JSON 结构（Advanced: structure 页）
fields.constraint: choice/score 必填、noul 可选；score 机器 spec minItems=1 而 docs api.md 写 You must include at least two levels（spec↔docs 分叉）；choice 选项数上限 255（blog 逐字 Jev supports a cardinality up to 255. + choice.md 逐字 A Choice question accepts up to 255 options）

official.quote: "criteria":{"additionalProperties":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"items":{},"type":"array"},{"type":"null"}]},"type":"object","title":"Criteria","description":"Choice names and descriptions of when each applies. A choice without a description is interpreted by its name alone.","examples":[{"angry":"An upset or hostile message","calm":"A neutral or polite message","excited":"An enthusiastic or eager message"}]}

fields.name: answers{}.score
fields.description: 打分题答案：按概率加权的期望分（probability-weighted average），可落在两档之间。官方明文勿用期望值做数值插值重建（jaggedness：score levels are weak in numerical calibration），只宜做阈值判断

official.quote: "score":{"type":"number","title":"Score","description":"Expected score: the probability-weighted average of the rubric levels. May fall between integer levels.","examples":[1.7]}

fields.name: answers{}.legend
fields.description: 档位图例：把请求 criteria 的各档按档位号（字符串键，从 0 起）映射回其描述，供解读 score 与 probabilities 的键

official.quote: "legend":{"additionalProperties":{"anyOf":[{"type":"string"},{"additionalProperties":true,"type":"object"},{"items":{},"type":"array"}]},"type":"object","title":"Legend","description":"The requested criteria mapped to their score levels, so you can interpret the score.","examples":[{"0":"Can wait","1":"Needs attention this week","2":"Needs attention today"}]}

fields.name: answers{}.probabilities
fields.description: 全量概率分布：choice 答案按选项名、score 答案按档位下标（字符串键，与 legend 同键）逐项给概率，官方口径合计约为 1（values sum to approximately 1）
fields.constraint: choice/score 答案均为 required 成员

official.quote: "probabilities":{"additionalProperties":{"type":"number"},"type":"object","title":"Probabilities","description":"Probability of each choice in criteria, keyed by choice name, from 0 to 1. Shows how likely the alternatives are; values sum to approximately 1.","examples":[{"angry":0.8,"calm":0.1,"excited":0.1}]}

fields.name: answers{}.confidence
fields.description: 置信度 0-1，由该答案的概率分布派生（confidence 页：与概率不同的第二轴，供路由/人审门控用）；仅 choice/score 答案携带，noul 答案无此字段

official.quote: "confidence":{"type":"number","title":"Confidence","description":"Confidence in the selected choice, from 0 to 1. Higher values indicate greater certainty; use lower values to flag uncertain selections for review.","examples":[0.9]}
